source: Fux, The Study of Counterpoint (trans. Mann, 1965), p. 29, Fig. 5: first species, counterpoint above the cantus firmus
transcription: Sounding pitches as MIDI numbers, durations in beats (a whole note is 4). The cantus firmus is Fux's Dorian cantus (Fig. 4). Fux's interval figures under the counterpoint: 5 3 3 5 3 5 3 3 6 6 8.
